gates.name: UNIT
gates.description: Unit tests pass across the package surface (passed == total run, no unexpected skips/errors).

gates.name: NUMERICAL_ORACLE
gates.description: Outputs match a trusted reference oracle (pandas/canonical semantics) within tolerance.

gates.name: PROPERTY
gates.description: Property/metamorphic invariants hold (idempotence, monotonicity, round-trip, shape preservation).

gates.name: CROSS_PACKAGE_CORE
gates.description: Core cross-package contracts hold: factor_engine -> quant_evaluator -> factor_assets. Import failure in the core chain is a FAIL, never a legitimate skip (0 skips tolerated).

gates.name: CROSS_PACKAGE_OPTIONAL
gates.description: Optional cross-package adapters: factor_preprocess / factor_optimizer may skip with an explicit 'not importable here' reason (wiring gap). Core-chain import failure is still a FAIL.

gates.name: LEAKAGE
gates.description: No look-ahead / PIT / label / temporal leakage in factors and labels.

gates.name: PIT
gates.description: Point-in-time availability semantics verified.

gates.name: DETERMINISM
gates.description: Same inputs + same pinned environment yield bit-identical outputs across runs/threads.

gates.name: SERIALIZATION
gates.description: Factor/plan/runtime objects survive pickling / format round-trips losslessly.

gates.name: CHECKPOINT_RESUME
gates.description: Long pipeline can checkpoint and resume from the last successful step.

gates.name: FRESH_WHEEL
gates.description: Package installs from a freshly built wheel and passes import/smoke. Superseded at release level by the FRESH_WHEEL_MATRIX gate (matrix across all release packages).

gates.name: 1K_SCALE
gates.description: Correctness/performance hold at 1K-row scale.

gates.name: 10K_SCALE
gates.description: Correctness/performance hold at 10K-row scale.

gates.name: 100K_SCALE
gates.description: Correctness/performance hold at 100K-row scale.

gates.name: ASHARE_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT_GOLDEN
gates.description: Semantic-contract golden suite for A-share data semantics (bp Return, backward Close*Factor, PIT PubDate, fail-closed industry source, percent normalization, effective-time-only dividend, IsSuspend from StockDailyBar). Can PASS from contract/golden helpers.

gates.name: ASHARE_REAL_DATA_SHADOW
gates.description: Real-data shadow: A-share semantics reproduced against REAL pinned parquet rows (data/a_share/lqtp_data mirror). Requires actual local A-share data; any skip/NEEDS-WIRING/synthetic-only evidence is NOT a pass.

gates.name: SOURCE_AUTHORITY
gates.description: Every source snapshot / manifest input is bound to a verifiable authority (real git SHA, real artifact digest), never a fabricated string.

gates.name: SUPPLY_CHAIN
gates.description: The dependency/install supply chain is pinned and reproducible (dependency lock hash, wheel provenance).

gates.name: SUBMODULE_REACHABILITY
gates.description: Any declared submodule pin is reachable/present in this checkout. With no submodules declared there is nothing pinned to prove -> NOT_RUN (never PASS).

gates.name: FRESH_WHEEL_MATRIX
gates.description: Matrix of fresh-wheel clean-install smoke checks across the release packages (supersedes the single-package FRESH_WHEEL gate).

gates.name: EVIDENCE_CURRENT
gates.description: evidence/current.py --check reports every artifact CURRENT (bound inputs == live inputs, executed_at present).
